text: paint/ing, n. 1. the act or occupation of cov- ering surfaces with paint. 2. the act, art, or occupation of picturing scenes, objects, persons, etc. in paint. 3, a picture in paint, as an oil, water color, ete. 4. colors laid on. [Obs.] 5. delineation that raises a vivid image in the mind; as, word-painting. [Obs.]
